source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of gene linkage, block for block, with Morgan's crosses as tables (PDF 100-102).

blocks.text: Jism ke cells mein hazaron genes mehdood (limited) tadaad ke chromosomes par hote hain. Misaal: insan ke taqreeban 20,000 genes 23 chromosomes par hain (jo do set mein hote hain), aur phal ki makkhi (Drosophila) ke taqreeban 13,000 genes 4 chromosomes par (yeh bhi do set mein). Is ka matlab hai ke har chromosome par bohat se genes aik qatar mein hote hain, kabhi bohat qareeb qareeb. Aik hi chromosome par maujood genes ko linked genes kehte hain, aur ise gene linkage kehte hain. Qareeb qareeb linked genes ikatthe rehte hain aur gametes bante waqt azad ho kar alag nahi hote. Lekin mukhtalif chromosomes par, ya aik chromosome par door door maujood genes, azad ho kar alag hote hain.
Gene linkage ka pata kaise chalta hai

Gene linkage aur us ki frequency (kitni baar hoti hai) crosses kar ke aur yeh dekh kar parhi jati hai ke bachchon mein mukhtalif phenotypes kitni baar aate hain. Asal baat yeh hai ke parental combinations (walidain jaise milap) ka muqabla recombinant ya naye milapon se kiya jaye.

blocks.title: For Information (maloomat)
blocks.text: Gene linkage sirf tab nazar aati hai jab cross se bohat se bachche paida hon. Bachchon (progeny) ki tadaad jitni zyada ho, utna hi zyada imkaan hai ke nateeja aabadi mein linkage ki asal frequency dikhaye.

items: Agar bachchon mein parental aur naye phenotypes barabar 1:1:1:1 ratio mein hon to genes linked nahi aur azad ho kar alag hote hain.
Agar parental milap zyada aur naye milap kam hon to yeh incomplete linkage hai: genes linked hain lekin crossing over se alag ho sakte hain.
Agar sirf parental milap aayen aur koi naya milap na ho to yeh complete linkage hai: genes bohat qareeb hain aur alag nahi hote.

blocks.text: Linkage ka pata lagane ki misaal

American biologist Thomas Hunt Morgan ne Drosophila mein do khasiyatein dekhin: paron (wings) ki lambai aur pait (abdomen) ki chaurai. Lambe paron ka allele (L) chhote ya vestigial (adhoore) paron (l) par dominant hai, aur chaure pait ka allele (B) patle pait (b) par dominant hai. Morgan ne yeh cross kiya:

blocks.caption: Morgan ka cross: walidain aur F1

blocks.text: Phir us ne F1 ki do makkhiyon ka aapas mein cross kiya. Nataij neeche ke figure mein hain.
Nateeje ki wazahat: law of independent assortment ke mutabiq F2 mein yeh 9:3:3:1 ratio honi chahiye thi:

blocks.caption: Independent assortment ke mutabiq mutawaqqa F2

blocks.text: Lekin Morgan ne F2 mein sirf parental milap dekhe: 3/4 makkhiyan lambe par aur chaure pait wali, aur 1/4 vestigial par aur patle pait wali.

blocks.alt: Makkhiyon aur un ke chromosome joron (dairon mein) ke saath cross. Walidain: lambe par, chaura pait LLBB x vestigial par, patla pait llbb. Sab gametes mein L-B ya l-b. F1: do LlBb makkhiyon ka cross; har aik L-B aur l-b gametes banati hai. F2 genotypes: 1/4 LLBB, 1/4 LlBb, 1/4 LlBb, 1/4 llbb. F2 phenotypes: 3/4 lambe par chaura pait, 1/4 vestigial par patla pait.
blocks.caption: Figure 18.10: Drosophila mein gene linkage (kitab ki Figure 18.10 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Labels: Parents, Gametes (All), F1, Gametes, F2 Genotype, F2 Phenotype, Long wing, broad abdomen, Vestigial wing, narrow abdomen.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Har daire mein makkhi ka chromosome jora hai. L aur B aik hi chromosome par, aur l aur b doosre par hain. Is liye gametes sirf L-B ya l-b le kar jate hain, kabhi L-b ya l-B nahi. F2 mein LLBB, LlBb, LlBb aur llbb bante hain: 3/4 lambe par chaura pait aur 1/4 vestigial par patla pait; koi naya milap nahi.
Is data se Morgan ne nateeja nikala ke paron ki lambai aur pait ki chaurai ke genes aik hi chromosome par hain aur woh azad ho kar alag nahi hote.

blocks.prompt: Aik testcross mein dono parental qismein 42% har aik aur dono nayi qismein 8% har aik aati hain. Yeh kya dikhata hai?
blocks.explanation: Parental qismein naye se kahin zyada hain, is liye genes linked hain; lekin nayi qismein bhi aa rahi hain, yaani crossing over kabhi kabhi unhein alag karta hai: yeh incomplete linkage hai.

items: Aik hi chromosome ke genes linked hain aur ikatthe aage jate hain.
1:1:1:1 linked nahi; parental zyada aur naye kam incomplete linkage; sirf parental complete linkage.
Morgan: mutawaqqa 9:3:3:1 ke bajaye F2 mein sirf parental qismein, 3 : 1; genes aik chromosome par.
